name: Ape
subject: A thin middle-aged woman of about 48, clearly a woman, with a woman's face and figure with light olive skin and a short white afro; a weathered oval face with a pointed chin, a broad flat nose, deep crow's feet and a small scar through one eyebrow. A herder raised in caves, quietly gifted, with a warm but wary look. She wears padded cloth armour under a heavy parka and a string of beads. Facing three-quarter right.
pose: One hand gripping a wooden herding staff at chest height, the head tilted slightly, a guarded half smile.
